criteria.requirement: Introduce string-compatible RecordName for non-None actual caller module names and explicit format spec short:N (positive decimal count of full trailing segments), optionally followed by | and a normal string format spec. Abbreviate preceding dotted segments to first Unicode characters, preserving empty segments, full stored value, JSON, pickle and all old standard str formats including numeric width. Integrate real Logger formatting, preserve None caller metadata unchanged, reject invalid new specs and avoid adding a replacement truncated record field or silently redefining {name:2}.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
